definitions.gloss: to invite, to ask to come

notes:
{招|まね}く is a transitive godan verb with meanings ranging from "to invite" to "to cause."

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜を{招|まね}く

MEANINGS:
1. To invite (people): {客|きゃく}を{招|まね}く (invite guests)
2. To beckon: {手|て}で{招|まね}く (wave someone over)
3. To cause/bring about: {災|わざわ}いを{招|まね}く (invite trouble)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {誤解|ごかい}を{招|まね}く: to cause a misunderstanding
- {批判|ひはん}を{招|まね}く: to invite criticism
- {注目|ちゅうもく}を{招|まね}く: to attract attention
- {招待|しょうたい}する: to invite (formal)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ} (beckoning cat) is a lucky charm placed at shop entrances to invite customers and good fortune.
